CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

September 24, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: September 10, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the September 10, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1836 South Chapel Avenue, DRB-2024-00059

  •  Request: This is an application for two (2) new CMU walls along the north and
  south property lines within the project site.
  •  Applicant: Marvin Wang

  1
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:

  1. The applicant shall provide the City with signed documents, such as a shared
  wall agreement letter or form, that confirms both adjacent property owners to
  the North (1830 South Chapel) and South (1840 South Chapel) are in
  agreement with the proposed wall(s) to be built along the property lines.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall provide the City with a signed document, such as a shared
  wall agreement letter, or a certified letter that notifies the adjacent property
  owner(s) to the North (1830 South Chapel) about the proposed wall to be built
  along the property line.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  30 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00095

  •  Request: This is an application for various signs for an existing commercial tenant
  frontage for business known as “Chicha San Chen” and re-painting of the
  storefront stucco.
  •  Applicant: Dan Luong
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise the plans to show additional dimensions for the location of the proposed
  signs as it relates to the building / building frontage.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ITEM 4:  201 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00076

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) new wall sign mounted on the roof
  fascia facing West Main Street on an existing 1-story commercial building, for
  business known as “Kue’s”.
  •  Applicant: Paul Wu
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall present the two following design options of the proposed
  sign for the City Architect to review and approve: 1) Remove the white trim
  from the “Chinese Kitchen & Bar” lettering and making the “Kues” lettering and
  logo larger in size; and 2) Enlarge the overall sign and backing panel, while
  maintaining the backing shape and complying with the total allowable signage
  area per City code.
  2. Revise the plans to show additional overall dimensions and centerline for the
  proposed sign as it relates to the building frontage and roof.
  3. After a design option is selected per Condition #1, the applicant shall resubmit
  a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:52 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on October 8, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:52 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng

  3
